verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to trigger a LightSprint agent from a CI/CD pipeline, such as a GitHub Action step, CLI, API or webhook that starts an agent on a failed build. 'GitHub Actions work out of the box' only means existing Actions run on LightSprint's PRs, which is adjacent, not agent triggering. Tasks start from Slack, Linear or Jira, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so no public trigger API is evidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an agent from CI/CD pipelines to fix a broken build or failing test
